upper_division.rule: At least 45 credits must be at the 300-500 level or equivalent. The ordinary program necessarily contributes 37 upper-level core credits, nine upper-level CMSC elective credits, ENGR 395, and a three-credit 300-400-level MATH course, for 50 modeled upper-level credits.

residency.rule: At least 25 percent of the degree must be completed at VCU, including at least 30 of the final 45 credits at VCU, subject to the published exceptions.

modeling_notes: The authoritative degree table publishes 120 credits, while its printed gross rows exceed 120 because designated ancillary courses satisfy ConnectED categories. This composition represents those courses once and reserves 21 additional ConnectED credits so the canonical unit budget closes at the published 120-credit minimum.

The 21-credit net ConnectED capacity contains the six nonoverlapping focused-inquiry foundation credits and 15 additional breadth/area-of-inquiry credits. The underlying gross rule remains 30 ConnectED credits: foundations, nine breadth-of-knowledge credits, and 20-21 area-of-inquiry credits with breadth courses included in the area total.

The canonical variable-credit path uses a four-credit natural-science lecture/lab sequence and nine open-elective credits. The five-credit PHYS path instead carries eight open-elective credits, keeping the combined capacity at 13.

CMSC 254 is displayed in the core table, but the special-requirements text makes it placement-dependent and says it may count as elective credit when required. The four-credit slot therefore exposes either CMSC 254 or equivalent applicable elective capacity after placement exemption without changing the 120-credit minimum.

CMSC 491 and CMSC 492 are retained in the official nine-credit upper-level elective menu with their published variable credit. The catalog states a credit minimum rather than a universal three-course count, so exact repeat/variable-credit evaluation remains a downstream constraint.
VCU REAL, GPA, major-grade, upper-level, and residency requirements are retained as policy requirements and audit declarations rather than omitted because they add no separate credits.

data_quality_flags.message: The live 2026-2027 Bulletin is labeled preliminary/launch and says program and General Education content may change before finalization.
The catalog permits designated ancillary courses to satisfy ConnectED categories; category distribution, prefix limits, and no-double-count rules need an attribute-aware evaluator.
CMSC 254 is placement-dependent; an evaluator must distinguish students required to take it from students who fill the same degree capacity with other applicable credit.
CMSC 491 and CMSC 492 have variable credit inside a nine-credit menu; repetition and exact credit fulfillment are not represented by a simple course-count solver.
